question: Should this Supply mother issue remain the umbrella, or should it be rewritten or superseded after mapping the remaining blocks to Buying, Shipping, and Warehouse block issues?
rationale: Current dev has moved part of the work into narrower Buying and Shipping BL blocks, but the original Supply checklist still contains unresolved areas and automation should not choose the permanent domain taxonomy.

options.title: Update and keep the umbrella
options.body: Keep this issue open, rewrite its checklist to link the completed Buying/Shipping blocks and name the remaining Supply or Warehouse blocks explicitly.

options.title: Supersede with narrower issues
options.body: Create or identify canonical issues for the remaining incidents, suspicious-orders, B2B, and warehouse lifecycle work, then close this umbrella with those links.

options.title: Pause until open BL PRs land
options.body: Wait for the open Buying eligibility and account PRs to merge before deciding whether this umbrella still adds routing value.

recommendation.title: Update and keep the umbrella
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, rewrite its checklist to link the completed Buying/Shipping blocks and name the remaining Supply or Warehouse blocks explicitly.

likelyOwner.reason: JavierHamelyn opened the umbrella and authored the BL pipeline skill, so they are the best available owner for the taxonomy decision.
